title: peucedanum alpinum
intro: Peucedanum alpinum, commonly known as alpine hog's fennel, is a plant species belonging to the carrot family. It has been used in traditional medicine for its various health benefits, including anti-inflammatory, antioxidant, and antimicrobial properties, which may help to alleviate digestive issues, reduce fever, and promote wound healing. The therapeutic actions of Peucedanum alpinum include expectorant, antispasmodic, and diuretic properties, which can help to relieve respiratory issues, muscle spasms, and fluid retention. The bioactive constituents of Peucedanum alpinum include coumarins, phenolic acids, and essential oils, which contribute to its medicinal properties and potential health benefits.
